subject.title: Feature request: Shareable cron job templates

question: Should ClawHub support shareable cron-job templates, and if so what artifact and trust model should own browse, preview, and one-click scheduled installation?
rationale: Current main has adjacent catalog primitives but no scheduled-template contract, and choosing one affects product scope, package compatibility, moderation, and security boundaries.

options.title: Define the model first
options.body: Write or sponsor a focused product/security spec for the artifact type, install authority, preview requirements, moderation handling, and OpenClaw runtime contract before implementation.

options.title: Constrain to existing surfaces
options.body: Treat cron templates as skill or bundle-plugin content and document conventions without adding a new package family or one-click install surface yet.

options.title: Defer the marketplace
options.body: Leave scheduled templates out of ClawHub for now because the current roadmap prioritizes security, stability, setup reliability, and existing plugin/skill distribution.

recommendation.title: Define the model first
recommendation.body: Write or sponsor a focused product/security spec for the artifact type, install authority, preview requirements, moderation handling, and OpenClaw runtime contract before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent package-family, validation, and product-scope work makes this the best current routing candidate for deciding whether a new package/install surface belongs in ClawHub.
